# Explore Suriname

> Independent travel and lifestyle guide to Suriname (South America), written and kept current by people who live there. Covers places to eat, stay and visit, plus live SRD exchange rates, flights, weather and local news. The site is regenerated about every 15 minutes, so rates and schedules stay current.

## Places
- [Restaurants](https://exploresuriname.com/restaurants.html): 186 places to eat across Suriname, spanning Creole, Hindustani, Javanese, Chinese and Maroon cooking.
- [Hotels and Lodges](https://exploresuriname.com/hotels.html): 119 options, from Paramaribo city hotels to interior jungle lodges reached by boat or small plane.
- [Things to Do](https://exploresuriname.com/activities.html): 110 nature parks, tours, attractions and experiences in one list, including UNESCO-listed rainforest, Brownsberg, Galibi, Bigi Pan, river trips, birdwatching and Maroon and Indigenous village visits.
- [Shopping](https://exploresuriname.com/shopping.html): 310 shops, malls and markets.
- [Local Services](https://exploresuriname.com/services.html): 691 banks, pharmacies, salons and other everyday services.
- [Events and Festivals](https://exploresuriname.com/events.html): annual festivals, public holidays and one-off events, with dates.

## Travel guides
- [The Basics](https://exploresuriname.com/visitor-guide.html): visas, customs, SIM cards, money, ATMs and getting around for first-time visitors.
- [Is Suriname Safe?](https://exploresuriname.com/is-suriname-safe.html): practical safety guidance for tourists.
- [About Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/about-suriname): country fact file: geography, climate, population and ethnic groups, languages, religion, history, government, economy, nature, the ten districts, national symbols, public holidays and practical facts.
- [History of Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/suriname-history.html): interactive timeline of Surinamese history, from the first Indigenous peoples through slavery and Keti Koti to independence and the oil era, in English and Dutch.
- [Flora & Fauna of Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/flora-fauna/): every animal, plant and fungus recorded in Suriname (about 18,500 species, 4,000 profiles) with names in English, Dutch, Spanish, Chinese, Sranan Tongo and Latin, where each species has been recorded by district, photos and sources.
- [Suriname Itinerary](https://exploresuriname.com/suriname-itinerary.html): suggested multi-day routes combining Paramaribo and the interior.
- [On the Road](https://exploresuriname.com/on-the-road.html): driving, road rules, rainy-season advice and emergency numbers.

## Live data
- [SRD Exchange Rates](https://exploresuriname.com/currency.html): Surinamese Dollar rates from CBVS (the central bank, official reference) and CME (the cash market). The cash rate is what travellers actually receive at exchange offices in Paramaribo, not the mid-market rate shown by global currency converters.
- [Flights](https://exploresuriname.com/flights.html): arrivals and departures for Johan Adolf Pengel International (PBM) and Eduard Alexander Gummels (EAX) airports.
- [Weather and Tides](https://exploresuriname.com/conditions.html): seven-day district forecasts, river tidal predictions and sunrise and sunset times.
- [Daily Notices](https://exploresuriname.com/daily-notices.html): on-call pharmacies, power and water outage notices, and cinema showtimes.
- [ATM Finder](https://exploresuriname.com/atms.html): every ATM in Suriname on a map with live up/down status where the bank publishes it, plus which cards each machine accepts (BNETS, Mastercard, Visa, foreign cards).
- [Sports in Suriname Time](https://exploresuriname.com/matches.html): Natio Suriname internationals, the Suriname Major League, the Concacaf Caribbean Cup, world football (Champions League, Premier League, Eredivisie, World Cup when it runs and more), NBA games and fight nights (UFC, Glory Kickboxing, boxing) with every start time converted to Suriname time (UTC-3), plus recent results.
- [Suriname Time and World Clock](https://exploresuriname.com/suriname-time.html): current Suriname time (UTC-3, no daylight saving), a live world-clock band and a two-way time-zone converter with a Netherlands call-overlap helper.

## Oil and gas
- [Suriname Oil and Gas Overview](https://exploresuriname.com/oil-and-gas.html): the whole sector in one page. Suriname has no offshore production yet; first oil from the GranMorgu development in Block 58 is targeted for 2028, while onshore fields produce around 17,000 barrels a day. Includes live Brent crude and the latest sector headlines.
- [Offshore Blocks and Operators](https://exploresuriname.com/suriname-oil-blocks.html): block-by-block table of who operates what offshore Suriname (TotalEnergies on Block 58, PETRONAS on Block 52, APA on Block 53, Chevron and Shell in shallow and deep acreage), the discovery-well record and the Open Door Offering.
- [The GranMorgu Project](https://exploresuriname.com/granmorgu.html): Suriname's first offshore oil development. US$10.5 billion sanctioned in October 2024, a 220,000 barrel per day FPSO, up to 32 wells, TotalEnergies 40% / APA 40% / Staatsolie 20%, first oil targeted 2028.
- [Oil Timeline and Roadmap](https://exploresuriname.com/suriname-oil-timeline.html): from the 1928 traces and Staatsolie's founding in 1980 to the 2020 discoveries, the 2024 final investment decision, first oil in 2028 and possible first gas around 2030.
- [Petroleum Contracts and Fiscal Terms](https://exploresuriname.com/suriname-oil-contracts.html): how Suriname's production sharing contracts work, the 6.25% royalty, cost oil and profit oil, the 36% income tax, Staatsolie's 20% back-in right, past bid rounds and how to bid.
- [Who Governs the Oil](https://exploresuriname.com/suriname-oil-government.html): the Ministry of Oil, Gas and Environment (created 2025, Minister Patrick Brunings), Staatsolie, the National Environment Authority and the Savings and Stabilisation Fund, plus what the IMF says is unfinished.
- [Oil and Gas Jobs and Local Content](https://exploresuriname.com/suriname-oil-jobs.html): supplier registration through the SSRP and SAP Ariba, offshore safety and NATIN training routes, realistic job expectations and why Suriname still has no local content law.

## Daily games
- [Sabi Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/quiz.html): free daily five-question quiz about Suriname, in Dutch and English.
- [Switi Mini](https://exploresuriname.com/crossword.html): daily Surinamese mini crossword with mixed Dutch, Sranan and English clues.
- [Pe A De?](https://exploresuriname.com/map-game.html): daily map game; tap the official map of Suriname (Tigri area included) to locate five real places.
- [Korjaal Run](https://exploresuriname.com/korjaal.html): arcade river game; steer a korjaal past logs, rocks and rapids on a shared daily river.
- [Aboma](https://exploresuriname.com/anaconda.html): snake game, Suriname style; grow an anaconda by eating piranhas, build combos and dodge driftwood.


## Business tools (free, for Surinamese businesses)
- [Business Tools for Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/business): All free tools and guides for Surinamese businesses in one place.
- [BTW Calculator Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/btw-calculator): Add or remove BTW at 10%, 5%, 25% or 0%, check whether you must register and estimate late-filing fines.
- [Salary Calculator Suriname (Gross to Net)](https://exploresuriname.com/salary-calculator): Net pay, wage tax, AOV, pension, FVO and the employer's total cost, checked against official rules.
- [Minimum Wage & Overtime Pay Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/minimum-wage-suriname): The current minimum hourly wage, monthly equivalent and overtime pay at 150%, 200% and 300%.
- [Timesheet & Work Hours Calculator](https://exploresuriname.com/timesheet): Add up work hours per week, flag the legal limits and calculate pay including overtime.
- [Holiday Days & Holiday Allowance Calculator](https://exploresuriname.com/vacation-calculator): Statutory holiday days, the holiday allowance and the payout at termination under the Vakantiewet.
- [Payslip Generator](https://exploresuriname.com/payslip-generator): Make a clear payslip (loonstrook) as PDF for each employee, calculated with the official rules.
- [Income Tax Calculator for Self-Employed](https://exploresuriname.com/income-tax-calculator): Estimate income tax and AOV on your yearly profit and how much to set aside each month.
- [Tax Deadlines Calendar Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/tax-deadlines): Every BTW, wage tax, AOV, APF and income tax deadline, with a calendar you can subscribe to.
- [Working Days Calculator Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/working-days-calculator): Count working days or add them to a date, skipping weekends and Surinamese public holidays.
- [Price & Markup Calculator](https://exploresuriname.com/pricing-calculator): Turn a USD or EUR cost into an SRD shelf price with live bank rates, margin and BTW.
- [Import Cost Calculator Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/import-cost-calculator): Estimate import duty, statistics and consent fees and BTW, and the landed cost per unit.
- [Invoice & Quote Generator (BTW-proof)](https://exploresuriname.com/invoice-generator): Make invoices and quotes that contain every field the BTW law requires, as PDF, free.
- [Receipt Maker (Kwitantie / Kassabon)](https://exploresuriname.com/receipt-generator): Make a numbered receipt with the amount written in words, as PDF or for a receipt printer.
- [Payment Reminder Generator](https://exploresuriname.com/payment-reminder): Write a polite payment reminder and send it by WhatsApp or e-mail.
- [BTW Register & Cashbook](https://exploresuriname.com/btw-register): Log sales and purchases and see your monthly BTW return figures.
- [Amount in Words (Bedrag in Letters)](https://exploresuriname.com/amount-in-words): Write any SRD amount out in Dutch or English words for receipts, cheques and contracts.
- [Cash Counter & Cash-Up](https://exploresuriname.com/cash-counter): Count notes and coins, add dollars and euros, and compare with the expected amount.
- [Loan & Lease Calculator](https://exploresuriname.com/loan-calculator): Monthly payment, total interest and a repayment table for a business loan or lease.
- [Break-Even & CBM Calculator](https://exploresuriname.com/break-even-calculator): How many units you must sell to cover costs, and the volume of a shipment in CBM.
- [QR Code Generator (Wi-Fi, Link, WhatsApp)](https://exploresuriname.com/qr-code-generator): Free QR codes for your website, Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, contact card or reviews. They never expire.
- [Barcode & Price Label Maker](https://exploresuriname.com/barcode-generator): Make EAN-13 or Code128 barcodes and print price labels on A4.
- [PDF Tools: Merge, Split, Sign](https://exploresuriname.com/pdf-tools): Merge, split, rotate, sign and stamp PDFs or turn photos into a PDF, all on your own device.
- [Image Resizer & Photo Tools](https://exploresuriname.com/image-tools): Resize and compress photos, crop for social media and remove location data.
- [Business Card & Email Signature Maker](https://exploresuriname.com/business-card-maker): Print business cards with a QR code and make a professional e-mail signature.
- [Government Tenders & Announcements](https://exploresuriname.com/government-tenders): The latest government tenders and announcements, plus Belastingdienst notices, updated daily.
- [Maximum Prices of Basic Goods](https://exploresuriname.com/max-prices-basic-goods): The official maximum consumer and wholesale prices of basic goods, searchable.
- [Starting a Business in Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/start-business-suriname): The official steps to register a business: KKF, tax number, BTW, staff and licences.
- [BTW in Suriname: A Plain Guide](https://exploresuriname.com/btw-guide-suriname): Rates, the registration threshold, invoices, deadlines and fines, with official sources.
- [Hiring Staff in Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/hiring-staff-suriname): Wage tax, AOV, pension, FVO, minimum wage, hours and holidays for employers.
- [Import & Export in Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/import-export-suriname): How customs declarations work and what you pay, with official links.
- [Business Financing in Suriname](https://exploresuriname.com/business-financing-suriname): Loans, guarantees and support programmes for Surinamese businesses.
- [Government Contacts for Businesses](https://exploresuriname.com/government-contacts-suriname): Addresses, phone numbers and opening hours of the Belastingdienst, customs, KKF and APF.
